messages:
sam: Tiny-win check! Drop a one-liner about your day + confess one weird snack habit. Bonus points for bread puns. 😄
devin: I just fixed a flaky test that had haunted me for a week. One-liner: 'I came, I saw, I mocked.' Snack confession: I microwave plain rice and eat it with soy sauce like cereal. :bowl_with_spoon:
maria: One-liner: 'Today I negotiated with a printer and won.' Snack confession: I slice cucumber and dunk it in peanut butter. No shame. :cucumber: :peanut:
linda: One-liner: 'Replaced two semicolons and saved three meetings.' Snack confession: I put butter on toast and then add a sprinkle of chili flakes. Bread pun: "I'm on a roll." :bread:
jing: One-liner: 'Made the build less sad.' Snack confession: I stash half a baguette in my desk and call it my emergency carb. :baguette_bread:
ops-bot: FYI — kitchen-fridge reminder: please label your stash (name + date) or we'll declare it community property next Friday. :bell:
sam: Love the baguette bunker idea, jing. Also 1-up: if you leave an unlabelled croissant it becomes the office mascot. :tada:
maria: @linda chili flakes on toast is peak energy. Adding it to my morning ritual. :thumbsup:
devid: (typo rescue) DEVIN: Also, who took the rye that was labelled 'sam - do not touch'? :eyes:
sam: not me? maybe the croissant mascot ate it. :sweat_smile:
linda: I vote for a weekly bread basket donation day. Bring one, take one. :handshake:
jing: Agreed. Also pro tip: freeze half your baguette and toast slices later. Life hack and mess containment.
maria: Micropraise: thanks everyone for keeping the kitchen weird but lovely. :sparkles:
sam: End of thread: winner of the weird snack award goes to… microwave rice with soy. Dev, claim your crown. :crown:
